quarterly_data.quarter: Furukawa Electric press release: Accelerating Development of Mass-Production Technologies (10-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: A four-company joint R&D proposal led by NTT Innovative Devices with Japan Semiconductor (a Toshiba Electronic Devices & Storage subsidiary), Furukawa Electric and Shinko Electric Industries, with NTT as advisor, was selected under NEDO's Post-5G advanced-semiconductor manufacturing technology project to establish mass-production technologies for photonics-electronics convergence (optical chiplet) devices for next-generation AI computing. The partners will develop manufacturing, testing and packaging technologies for optical chiplets, silicon photonics for heterogeneous integration, compound-semiconductor optical devices and optical chiplet packaging, build and evaluate a pilot production line for future commercial manufacturing, and target more than a tenfold increase in manufacturing productivity versus current R&D-stage processes.
quarterly_data.figure: more than a tenfold manufacturing productivity increase targeted
